connector.name: Garminmcp
connector.registryDescription: Privacy-first unofficial Garmin Connect MCP for AI health, sleep, activity & recovery agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package garmin-mcp-unofficial. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GARMIN_TOKEN_PATH
env.description: Optional local path for Garmin Connect tokens. Defaults to ~/.garmin-mcp/garmin_tokens.json. Create it with garmin-mcp-server auth (self-contained Node login, no Python).

env.name: GARMIN_PRIVACY_MODE
env.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured. raw means full supported Garmin Connect payloads, not unrestricted raw sensor telemetry.

env.name: GARMIN_CACHE
env.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

env.name: GARMIN_CACHE_PATH
env.description: Optional local SQLite cache path. Defaults to ~/.garmin-mcp/cache.sqlite.

env.name: GARMIN_DOMAIN
env.description: Optional Garmin domain override. Use garmin.cn only for China accounts; default is garmin.com.

env.name: GARMIN_NO_CACHE
env.description: Set to true to bypass the in-memory HTTP response cache (60s TTL for GET only). POST/PUT/DELETE and 4xx/5xx responses are never cached regardless.
